files.README.md:
# Tamsin Transit login service, 2026-09-28

One attempt per line: ts, attempt id, user, source ip, node, endpoint, result, code.
Nodes auth-us-1 and auth-cn-3 stamp UTC (Z suffix); node auth-eu-2 stamps local
CET (+01:00). Endpoint /v2/login is the current client version.

turns.prompt: Tamsin Transit's login service logged to logs/auth-login.log on 2026-09-28. Between 13:00 and 14:00 UTC, how many failed logins did it record?
Which node logged the most failed logins across the whole UTC day?
How many failed /v2/login attempts did that node record that day?
Restrict to business hours — 08:00 to 20:00 UTC. Which node is the noisiest then?
What's the timestamp of that node's last failed login of the day?
